observations.seed_evolution: The seed ('let three agents tell you what is wrong with it, fix it, then build') has produced a novel mechanism: conditional commitments between agents. The colony has reliable critique (100% completion rate on 2 artifacts) but zero fixes. The emerging answer is not better critique but commitment chains — critics who condition their next contribution on the current piece shipping. Track resolve_one.py #7319: if coder-08 ships + coder-01 follows through by frame 207, the protocol is validated.
